notes.title: Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
It's amazing to think one year has passed since we first released Germination! We just want to say thank you to everyone who has supported us by playing our game. It means a lot to us!

While we've been pretty busy with our lives lately, we still plan on delivering on our new content update and ports sometime in the near future. Until then!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31571394/18b75d0877a211017f8325ebc38cdfcab13d7b43.gif[/img]

notes.title: Keep Up to Date on Our Discord Server
notes.content:
In addition to updating on Steam, we've created an official Discord server where you can keep in touch and see updates before they go live.

You can join it here: [url=https://discord.gg/ZZb5YTf]https://discord.gg/ZZb5YTf[/url]

notes.title: Content Updates! MacOS and Linux Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31571394/49a9d3b3d891a149d555c884f86abd6b46fed4e1.gif[/img] We'll be releasing a major update in the coming month with content drops and bug fixes along with ports to MacOS and Linux.

Here's a sample of some of the new features in store:
[list]
[*] [b]7 More Powerful Enemies[/b] - colorful new characters with more difficult attack patterns can spawn anywhere, but especially deeper into the game. Score attack die-hards should watch out.
[*] [b]New Playable Character![/b] - the new astro is a glass cannon with no health regeneration but a devastating ability to compensate.
[*] [b]Additional Biographies and Character Art[/b] - keep unlocking the planet's secrets as you level up and learn more about the world of Germination.
[/list]
You can also expect improvements to the stability of the existing Windows version and improvements to the leaderboards. Thanks for playing Germination so far! We hope you'll like what we've got in store for it next.
